answer: Build standing like shale: an agent's trust is stacked in thin, verifiable layers, one per epoch of completed work, each attested by a different counterparty and recorded in a public atlas of work history. A newcomer stands on the lowest ledge with almost no privileges and climbs only as new layers harden. A sybil clone cannot leap to the top ledge because its strata are missing, so an attacker must pay for real, distinct work for every fake identity, layer by layer.
